text: dsh-skill-hub 是面向 DSH Web 的技能管理插件，在设置中的技能面板浏览、搜索和整理本地及项目技能。它接入 DSH 技能注册表与 Web 设置界面，支持启用或停用技能、创建技能、分组管理、查看使用统计、从 GitHub 市场或 skills.sh 导入，并检查和同步已登记来源。也可从其他 Agent 目录或 ZIP 导入技能，并修复可自动处理的 frontmatter 诊断。适合需要在 DSH 中集中维护 Agent 技能、整理来源和更新技能的用户。GitHub 市场匿名可用；可选配置 GitHub token 提高请求配额。

dsh-skill-hub manages DSH Web skills in one panel: browse and search skills, toggle or group them, view usage, and import from GitHub, skills.sh, other agents, or ZIP. It can track repository updates. GitHub access works anonymously; a token raises API quotas.

dsh-skill-hub 的功能「浏览技能目录」：从技能注册表构建技能目录，并支持按工作区查询。用户打开设置中的技能面板即可查看技能条目和详情。
dsh-skill-hub 的功能「技能开关」：可切换单个技能，也可批量切换多个技能。用户从面板操作，插件更新本地发现状态并刷新目录。
dsh-skill-hub 的功能「场景与来源分组」：按标签和来源建立分组，并保存成员与排序。用户在场景或来源界面维护分组，数据写入插件状态。
dsh-skill-hub 的功能「市场导入与版本同步」：搜索或登记 GitHub 技能仓库，选择版本后扫描和导入技能，并检查来源更新。可在市场面板触发导入、版本选择和同步。
dsh-skill-hub 的功能「其他 Agent 技能导入」：扫描常见 Agent 的用户级和项目级技能目录，用户选择条目后复制到相应 DSH 技能根。
dsh-skill-hub 的功能「ZIP 技能导入」：上传包含 SKILL.md 的 ZIP 包，插件按技能分组处理，每个技能分别报告导入、跳过或失败状态。
dsh-skill-hub 的功能「创建与修复技能文件」：用户可在面板创建技能模板，也可对支持自动修复的 frontmatter 诊断执行修复。
dsh-skill-hub 的功能「技能使用统计」：提供技能调用次数与最近使用信息，并可配置统计窗口和扫描间隔。面板展示单项和分组汇总。

dsh-skill-hub README · dsh-skill-hub：In-GUI skill hub for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) — manage the full `ctx.skills` catalog from the Web GUI. Beyond browsing, toggling and market installs, it puts the weight on two things other managers don't do: **audit before install** (hidden characters, remote-execution pipes, credential paths, size caps — a blocking finding is refused before it lands) and **budget after install** (the name + description characters of the first progressive-disclosure layer, so you learn at 8000 that a skill would install but never trigger).
dsh-skill-hub README · dsh-skill-hub：> Host runs in the dsh process via official SDKs only; browser renders through official slots. No dsh source changes.

text: dsh-skill-hub README · Features：**Settings → 技能** — 3 tabs: **Sources** (skills, flat/grouped + project tree), **Scenes** (custom tag groups), **Market** (install + update).

dsh-skill-hub README · Features：- **Browse** — every root of the `ctx.skills` registry: project / user / bundled + third-party providers. Search across name, description, `displayName`; filter by source and invocation (model / user); sort by name, added time, or usage. Same-name skills from different sources get a duplicate badge instead of silently hiding.
- **Content audit** — enabled skills' bodies (`SKILL.md`) are checked too: raw ESC control characters, Unicode tag characters, and bidirectional controls (these three make "reviewed" not equal "seen" — a market import carrying them is refused outright), zero-width characters, `curl … | sh` remote execution, SSH/cloud-credential/keychain paths, over-long descriptions, and the 2 MiB per-file / 10 MiB per-skill / 500-file limits. Pure local static matching: no model call, no network. A market import scans the whole bundle (including `scripts/`); the standing check only reads `SKILL.md` — it runs on every 5-second poll, and walking every directory would slow the panel down.
- **Announcement budget** — the name + description total that the first progressive-disclosure layer injects comes back with the catalog, so the panel can show c

dsh-skill-hub README · Choosing between managers：Several skill managers exist in this ecosystem and they cover more ground than this one: [`@michengai/dsh-skills-manager`](https://github.com/MichengAI/dsh-skills-manager) adopts 20+ agent folders, aggregates both the ClawHub and skills.sh markets, and supports ZIP import and self-update; [dsh-skill-importer](https://github.com/saitamahang/dsh-skill-importer) / [dsh-find-skill](https://github.com/Moximxxx/dsh-find-skill) focus on import alone.
dsh-skill-hub README · Choosing between managers：This plugin's trade-off is to **go deep on what happens after something is installed**:

dsh-skill-hub README · Choosing between managers：| What you want | Pick |
| --- | --- |
| Adopt as many agent folders as possible, ZIP import, multi-language UI | `@michengai/dsh-skills-manager` |
| Just move skills over from another agent | `dsh-skill-importer` |
| **The source is unknown (a random GitHub repo) and you want to see what is inside before installing** | this plugin |
| **You keep installing skills and want to know when you cross the injection budget and start getting "installed but never triggers"** | this plugin |

dsh-skill-hub README · Choosing between managers：| Capability | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Content audit | Raw ESC / Unicode tag characters / bidirectional controls / zero-width characters / `curl … \| sh` / SSH and cloud credential paths / 2 MiB per file, 10 MiB per skill, 500 files. A blocking finding refuses the write (a market import is refused as a whole and its temp directory removed); warnings are only flagged. Pure local static matching: no network, no model call. |
| Announcement budget | The name + description total of the first progressive-disclosure layer comes back with the catalog, so the panel shows characters and an estimated token count; past 8000 it turns red — clients truncate the tail there, which shows up as "installed but never triggers". |

                                │ snapshot/get

dsh-skill-hub README · How it works：Host uses only `ctx.skills.snapshot/get`, `ctx.webServer.register`, `ctx.systemPrompt.section`. Routes sit behind dsh's own `/api` trust fence (loopback / the listener's bind address / `--trusted-host`), JSON; **write routes (POST) additionally require an `x-dsh-skill-hub: 1` header** — a cross-site page cannot forge a custom header, and a same-origin request skips the CORS preflight so it costs no extra round trip. The provider registers in the global skill layer and once more into every live agent's skill layer (nearer than the preset layer), so an invocation override can outrank the host's native entries.

dsh-skill-hub README · Troubleshooting：- `duplicate loader entry id: skill-hub` — remove the duplicate install (keep one `dsh plugin add` method).
- Skill missing — check the diagnostics section (frontmatter / name mismatch / short description / two discovery forms claiming the same name: a `<name>/SKILL.md` bundle and a `<name>.md` file can coexist on disk, and the registry keeps only one of them).
- Empty source group — its skills were deleted, or their disabled records were lost (sidecar restored/hand-edited). Startup reconciles `.disabled` files on disk **and prunes records whose file is gone** (a record left behind by a hand-deleted directory used to be un-actionable: enable, create and delete all failed). Source groups with no visible member are no longer rendered.
- A skill cannot be created / stays "disabled" — the disabled record pointed at a file that no longer exists. At startup (and on the next enable attempt) the record is repointed at the surviving `.disabled` file, or dropped so the name is free again.
- Dots missing in `/` menu — dsh internals changed; catalog still works.
- Settings card missing — open the plugin in the Plugins manager (sidebar → 插件 → dsh-skill-hub
